edit.description: Early same-clock historical forecasts, smoothly approach frozen static teachers
edit.interpolation: smoothstep; phase is normalized over observed score nodes; no extrapolation
edit.normalization: dose is normalized over actual score nodes to a mean of one

failure_modes: Affinity response is unverified: decoded final affinity labels are unobserved (recorded affinities removed, equal score prior), so no improvement in the primary objective can be claimed from this edit; only selection preference is available as a label.

The landmark_00_soft_mass trend is a selection-association contrast, not evidence of a reward effect; the non-monotone profile may not persist under the injected reward, and the cubic polynomial was not accepted, so the shape could be an artifact of the unaccepted fit.
Only landmark_00_soft_mass was read as an actual curve; other landmark coordinates were not inspected, so the recipe may be mismatched to unexamined coordinate features.

Strain and structural validity are secondary and were not assessed here; a graph or geometry change driven by this reward could degrade strain or validity without being detected by the cited evidence.

The blend schedule is a registered hypothesis, not a learned optimum; if the true temporal relevance is flat, S2_constant_blend would be indistinguishable, and the S1-vs-S3 contrast is the only falsification test available.
rationale: H001, supported by the actual landmark_00_soft_mass curve (Eef4385e476674774) and its continuous-trends row (E2e106e083189d150), reports a non-monotone rising-then-falling contrast over the observed score window [0.0,0.49] with an early positive rate and late negative rate, 4 sign changes and a strong sign conflict across 14 independent batches, with extrapolation disallowed. The clock observation (E0857891f4effbfe1) confirms the observed score nodes span 0.0-0.49 within the learning window [0.0,0.5], and the objective (Eaa4bda02c9a2c3a1) makes final predicted affinity primary with coordinate control only. Because the coordinate contrast is time-varying rather than a fixed absolute target, the registered reward-lane recipe S1_observed_to_static is the offered choice whose schedule (blend 1->0.5->0 over knots 0,0.5,1) lets early same-clock historical forecasts dominate and then smoothly approach frozen static teachers, matching the observed early-positive/late-negative structure without extrapolation. Dose factors are unchanged (all 1) and delta is frozen, so this is a reward-lane edit only.
